messages:
anya: quick thread  sales + partnerships asked for a special 'marketplace starter' shape for customers coming through partners. they want: elevated first-30-days throughput, partner-reconciled billing, and an easy migration path to paid tiers. thoughts?

priya: partners expect a separate SKU so they can attribute credits in their marketplace. otherwise reconciliation gets messy.

tom: runtime note: separating via SKU is simplest for telemetry and caps. we can tag requests by source=marketplace and route to starter profile.

marco: ops risk: marketplace launches tend to front-load signups. recommend a region-aware concurrent cap and a global soft quota for marketplace promos.

anya: ok SKU + request-tagging. do we make it default ON for marketplace signups? partners prefer auto-enable to avoid friction.

sylvia: legal/accounting: need distinct invoice lines and partner reporting fields. suggest sku = "MKP_STARTER_30" and invoice_meta.partner_id. Also require promo auto-expire and partner rebate rules.

priya: partners also asked for the ability to extend for high-value customers. propose sales API for partner-admins with audit trail and one-time extension +14 days.

tom: technical: add per-account promo object (start_ts, expiry_ts, source_tag) and a partner-admin scoped API. ops: enforce per-route token-bucket and promo_node_pressure metric.

marco: add a guard: if marketplace_promo_active_count > 1000 then flip new signups to manual enable and alert #eng-sre. protects capacity.

anya: launch criteria draft: 1) separate SKU flow through invoicing + partner reporting; 2) admin API + Console visibility for partner teams; 3) telemetry: p95 delta <1.6x during 24h canary; 4) global guard + region caps implemented; 5) docs & partner comms ready.

sylvia: will draft partner terms addendum and invoice sample. need partner legal sign-off before GA.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate: "mkp-starter-v1" built. canary scheduled 06:00 UTC -> 3%.

priya: partner experience ask: show promo badge and remaining days in partner dashboard and customer bill preview so no surprises.

tom: will add badge and bill-preview flag to API. backend will log source_tag with every request.

marco: telemetry hooks: promo_request_ratio_by_region, promo_extension_count_by_partner, promo_node_pressure. set automated rollback if p95 delta > 2x or sustained GPU util > 85%.

anya: Decision recap: implement marketplace starter as distinct promo SKU (MKP_STARTER_30), auto-enable for marketplace signups, partner-admin extension API (audited, +14 max), region/global guards, rollout behind feature flag with canary. Action items: Tom - API + tagging + canary; Sylvia - partner terms + invoice rows; Priya - partner comms + dashboard; Marco - telemetry + guard thresholds; Anya - update PRD and partner checklist.

sylvia: posting draft clause to #legal and cc partnerships.

priya: lining up two partners for pilot next week. will confirm opt-in flow.

anya: great. reconvene after 24h canary metrics and partner feedback. :white_check_mark:
